title: Britain's largest battery is actually a lake
summary: Tom Scott visits Dinorwig Power Station in Wales, a pumped-storage hydro plant often called Britain's largest battery. He explains how it works and how its role has shifted from TV pickup spikes to balancing wind and solar.
why: HN cites it whenever grid storage or pumped hydro comes up, as an accessible example of storage at scale.

quote.text: Its main use now is in balancing calm moments of solar and wind power generation, apparently.
